name: Default
shortDescription: Kanban boards for tracking issues and ideas, with SQLite storage, background jobs and uploads on one persistent volume.

alerts.message: HTTPS is required: Fizzy forces SSL and marks its session cookies secure, so signing in over a plain HTTP domain fails.

Sign-in sends a one-time code by email. Set the SMTP variables, or find the 6-character code in the container logs. The first account created owns the instance and further account signups are disabled.
